title: Design quality varies tremendously
text:
Some of the shirts are quite cool. Some look like they were designed by folks who don't watch Star Trek. My most recent shirt was white, with a slogan of "I'm kind of a big deal - Capt. Picard" on it.

Totally stupid. Not in character for Star Trek or Picard. So back is goes. But some are quite cool. It's just hit or miss. So long as you are prepared for it, it's fine.
label: neutral
